title: TextHash step configuration
description: Unsecure configuration for both TextHash steps (Create and Update): the logical names of the project's table and columns, and the duplicate message. The plug-in enforces the same rules at runtime (StepConfig.cs) and the tests keep the two in step.

targetTable.description: The table the steps are registered on.

textColumn.description: The text column whose content must be unique, e.g. a multiple lines of text column.

hashColumn.description: The single line of text column (64 characters) that receives the SHA-256 hash and is in the alternate key.

scopeLookup.description: Optional. The lookup the text must be unique within, e.g. the fund. It's in the alternate key with the hash. Leave it out for uniqueness across the whole table.

duplicateMessage.description: The message a user sees when the text is a duplicate.
